The real taste of Cyprus

Fresh fish and seafood from the charcoal grill, fish and meat meze and Cypriot dishes such as kleftiko and moussaka, on a terrace under the trees in Agios Tychonas, Limassol. Open every day from 15:00. 4.6 stars from 341 Google reviews.

From the menu

Cold starters and salads, fish and shellfish from the charcoal grill, Cypriot dishes, meze and desserts. There is also pasta, home-made pizza and a children’s menu. Prices at the restaurant.

Cold starters and salads

  • Fresh oysters on ice with lemon
  • Seafood platter with smoked salmon, trout, mussels, tuna and prawns, for two or more
  • Avocado with king prawns and cocktail sauce
  • Honey melon with hiromeri
  • Greek salad, tomato and onion salad, seafood salad

Fish from the grill

  • Sea bream and sea bass, grilled on charcoal with olive oil and lemon
  • Octopus grilled on charcoal
  • Calamari, grilled or fried
  • Fried red mullet
  • Swordfish steak or swordfish kebab
  • Seafood kebab with prawns, swordfish and salmon

Shellfish

  • Black tiger prawns grilled on charcoal, with rice
  • Local lobster, steamed or grilled
  • Jumbo prawns in ouzo cream sauce
  • Scallops and prawns on the skewer

Cypriot dishes, meze and dessert

  • Fish meze and meat meze for the whole table
  • Kleftiko and moussaka, vegetarian moussaka too
  • Baklava, kataifi and Cypriot village sweets
  • Yogurt with honey

At Danae

Photos from the tavern’s Google listing.

A terrace under the trees

Danae Tavern & Restaurant is in the tourist area of Agios Tychonas in Limassol, at Amathountos 92 in the Panorama Court. Guests sit on a terrace under a large tree hung with lanterns, or inside in a dining room with wooden walls. The menu has fish and seafood from the charcoal grill, oysters and lobster, Cypriot dishes such as kleftiko and moussaka, fish and meat meze, pasta, home-made pizza and a children’s menu. In the reviews guests mention the friendly service, the generous portions and the fruit and drink brought to the table at the end.

Today Danae has no website of its own: the Google listing has no website field. Checked on 23 September 2026.
